page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-88-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with high-capacity local storage. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8481C processor operating at 2.7 GHz, the instance supplies 88 vCPUs across 44 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The memory footprint total is 352 GB of RAM, sustaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4 GB per virtual core. It integrates 105 MB of L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and hardware instruction extensions including AVX-512, AMX-Tile, and AMX-INT8 matrix accelerators.

The instance includes 6,432 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 16 bundled physical drives. No discrete GPUs are attached, leaving compute and matrix execution entirely to the host CPU cores. In benchmark evaluations, multi-threaded operations consistently rank in the top quartile, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 73,268.7 and PassMark CPU reaching 73,489.6. Single-core performance sits in the middle 50% across Geekbench and stress-ng tests, indicating that throughput scales primarily via core density rather than elevated single-thread frequencies.

Data-intensive tests show strong subsystem performance. Uncached large-block read memory bandwidth achieves 224.79 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput measures 76.85 GB/sec and Redis operations register 85.97 million ops/sec. CPU-driven inference benchmarks demonstrate high throughput for small and medium language models during prompt processing, though token generation for larger models remains constrained by CPU execution limits.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c3-standard-88-lssd minimizes infrastructure footprint by combining high vCPU capacity with direct NVMe storage, eliminating external volume latency and extra network disk attachments. The primary architectural tradeoff is the ephemeral nature of local SSD arrays, requiring external replication strategies. The instance profile aligns with high-IOPS databases, static asset caching clusters, multi-threaded build systems, and distributed analytics pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-88-lssd is a general-purpose server configured with 88 vCPUs and 352 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio across 44 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8481C processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. The system integrates 6,432 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage across 16 bundled drives without attached GPUs. The architecture supports AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets, showing strong multi-core scalability across Geekbench, PassMark, and stress-ng benchmarks. Its I/O subsystem delivers 85.97 million Redis operations per second alongside 76.85 GB/sec of static web throughput. Single-core processing metrics remain in the middle tier, meaning aggregate performance relies heavily on multi-threaded parallelization. The bundled high-capacity NVMe array removes network storage bottlenecks, suiting this instance for low-latency databases, continuous integration build clusters, real-time analytics engines, and high-throughput data processing services.
